reviews.title: 140MM Infinity Fans are perfect fit for my Antec C8 Curved case
reviews.comment: I ordered two sets of these fans for my new Antec C8 curved glass case.  The case looks best with 140mm fans.  Each box of 3 fans comes with a controller.  I was unable to get the ARGB to work with the controller, so I just used the fans daisy chain ARGB ports to connect the fans in series to the ARGB on the motherboard and my ASAU Aura works perfectly.  I think this is a great deal!
reviews.author: Brian Lambertz

reviews.title: dont wast the money
reviews.comment: dont waste your money. The fans that I received that would actually spin were so loud I had to unplug them to hear my speakers. (this was even after adjusting the fan curves, and no they where not stuck at 100%). 3 out of the 9 I ordered didnt even work or quit completely shortly after turning them on. I havent even attempted to plug in the last 3 and am just using the stock cooling fans that came with my case. Also the controller that comes with them is rgb only and pretty janky. it only has maybe 5 settings.
reviews.author: notmyname

reviews.title: Absolutely no quality control
reviews.comment: They make clicking noises when moving the PC around, and one is buzzing right out of box. Returning after under 30 seconds of use. Please listen to the other reviews - these are garbage quality and not worth wasting your time installing and uninstalling. Even the stickers are so cheap, they're peeling off.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer
